title: Fists

sections.heading: Description
sections.text:
When a player attacks without a weapon, tool equipped, or use a dedicated Fist weapon such as the Flesh Rippers, they do a Fist strike. The primary attack is a punch, and the secondary attack is a kick that does additional knockback with 6x staggering. The punch has a 2-hit combo where the second punch (left hand) does double damage.
Bare fists can be useful against the weakest of enemies; especially when the player wants to avoid the cost of weapon durability. It also costs less stamina than most weapons.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Fists was previously named Unarmed prior to the Frost Caves update.

full_text:
Fists

Introduction. Fists is a weapon class.

Description. When a player attacks without a weapon, tool equipped, or use a dedicated Fist weapon such as the Flesh Rippers, they do a Fist strike. The primary attack is a punch, and the secondary attack is a kick that does additional knockback with 6x staggering. The punch has a 2-hit combo where the second punch (left hand) does double damage.
Bare fists can be useful against the weakest of enemies; especially when the player wants to avoid the cost of weapon durability. It also costs less stamina than most weapons.

Notes. • Fists was previously named Unarmed prior to the Frost Caves update.
